title: 4th Unique Awards — Final Batch of Jury Guests Announced
summary: 4th Unique Awards (非凡奖, since 2019) — digital commerce cases across MarTech, creative, sales conversion, experience. ~100 firms / ~200 cases submitted; first go-global track = 41.3% of cases; ~1/3 product / 2/3 service. Scoring links to jury next week; awards early Dec. Jury:

html:
Unique Research · Insight / Awards · November 24, 2022

4th Unique Awards (非凡奖, since 2019) — digital commerce cases across MarTech, creative, sales conversion, experience. ~100 firms / ~200 cases submitted; first go-global track = 41.3% of cases; ~1/3 product / 2/3 service. Scoring links to jury next week; awards early Dec. Jury: 100 experts across enterprise / brand / investor / academia / media committees.

This final guest batch (roles): Wang Yong — Youquhui (02177.HK) chair/CEO; Hong Lizhou — Bain global expert partner, Greater China marketing & ecom; Li Shuhao — Tiedong Tech founder (ex-UC India #1 / Alibaba intl growth); Dr. Song Bilian — Datatist founder, commercial AI (ex-eBay/LinkedIn); Hong Kai — JINGdigital chair/CEO (ex-Cisco SVP, Wharton MBA); Wang Aoyan — White Rabbit Holdings founder; Zhang Shudong — Kingsidea CEO (Haier/Midea go-global branding); Zhang Wenhao — Dudao Tech CEO (WeChat ops, IDG/CMB Ventures); Weng Peijun — HiPu ZhiTou founder (ex-Dentsu Aegis CPO); Li Lin — Yingshu Media founder; Cheng Wei — Insight Group securities/investment GM; Guan Zishan — Kaiyu Group strategy VP; Cao Di — Chimelong brand GM; Yang Zhen — Jidu Auto user-growth lead (ex-Alibaba/Youku/Tezign/Pepsi/P&G); Feng Jicun — Nike GC MarTech & AdTech; Zhao Sihan — NetEase Yanxuan Food BU; Wang Cheng — Convertlab COO (ex-CTO; SAP Anywhere); Xia Fei — Bicheng Digital; Tang Chao — Jinguang Network / Today Ad; Huang Haijun — Shuzhi Consulting / ToBBrand. Full bios & prior award galleries in CN images.

— END —
